title: Open-book HCI written exam with ChatGPT consultation
summary: Undergraduate HCI students complete a written exam while permitted to consult ChatGPT, textbooks, slides, and other materials. Questions emphasize application, analysis, and links to students' practical projects rather than direct recall or definitions.

sources.title: May We Consult ChatGPT in Our Human-Computer Interaction Written Exam? An Experience Report After a Professor Answered Yes

locator.section: 3. The HCI Course at the Federal University of Lavras

sources.evidence_quote: The semester in which the written exams with consultation to ChatGPT took place was in the second academic semester of 2022.

assessment.summary: Answer written HCI questions requiring applied reasoning and interpretation while consulting course resources and ChatGPT.
student_actions: Consult ChatGPT and other open-book resources.
Apply course concepts to practical design and evaluation contexts.

student_role.description: ChatGPT was explicitly available as a consultation resource during the written exam.

grading.method: Instructor grading of written exam answers; the detailed scoring rubric is not reported.

evidence.study_type: professor experience report and thematic analysis
reported_failures: ChatGPT produced incomplete answers, incorrect nudges, prompt-biased answers, and verbose generic content.
